{"timeline":[{"headline":"Formation of Rajasthan","text":"Rajasthan was formed on March 30, 1949, when Rajputana, as it was known then, was merged into the Dominion of India. The state was created by merging several princely states, chief among them being Jaipur, Jodhpur, Bikaner, and Udaipur.","date":"1949-03-30"},{"headline":"Capital Established","text":"Jaipur was declared the capital of Rajasthan upon its formation in 1949. Jaipur is one of the largest cities in the state and is known for its rich history and architecture.","date":"1949"},{"headline":"Rajasthan Reorganization Act","text":"The Rajasthan Reorganization Act was passed in 1956, which led to the reorganization of the state's boundaries. This act integrated several princely states and territories into Rajasthan, further solidifying its current geographical boundaries.","date":"1956"},{"headline":"Formation of the Thar Desert National Park","text":"In 1980, the Thar Desert National Park was established in Rajasthan. It is one of the largest national parks in India and is located in the Jaisalmer district, covering an area of about 3,000 square kilometers.","date":"1980"},{"headline":"Rajasthan's Economic Growth","text":"In the late 20th and early 21st centuries, Rajasthan experienced significant economic growth, particularly in tourism, agriculture, and mining. The state's rich cultural heritage and historical sites have made it a popular tourist destination.","date":"2000s"}]}
